Name: Remote Desktop Services Remote Code Execution (BlueKeep)
Synopsis: The remote host is affected by a remote code execution vulnerability.
Description: The Remote Desktop Services on the remote host are affected by a remote code execution flaw.
Solution: Apply the Microsoft security update or disable Remote Desktop.

Name: Windows Print Spooler Remote Code Execution (PrintNightmare)
Synopsis: The remote host is affected by a remote code execution vulnerability.
Description: The Windows Print Spooler service allows privilege escalation and remote code execution.
Solution: Apply the Microsoft update or disable the Print Spooler service.

Name: OpenSSH < 9.3p2 Remote Code Execution
Synopsis: The SSH server on the remote host is affected by a remote code execution vulnerability.
Description: The ssh-agent feature in OpenSSH before 9.3p2 has an insufficiently trustworthy search path.

Name: SSL Certificate Information
Synopsis: This plugin displays the SSL certificate.

Name: Default Credentials on Network Device (telnet)
Synopsis: The remote device accepts a well-known default login.
Description: The remote network device accepts the vendor default account over telnet.
Solution: Change the default password and disable telnet.
